verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim's Replicator generates labeled synthetic training data (randomized scenes, domain randomization for AMR/warehouse) and Isaac Lab provides GPU-accelerated, CUDA-graphable large-scale RL training with pluggable libraries (skrl, RLLib, rl_games) and physics engines, explicitly designed to train robot policies at scale from workstation to data center. This is well-documented first-party evidence covering both synthetic data generation and scaled RL simulation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks or case studies validating claimed scale/performance beyond vendor docs.
